image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of an iguana's head and upper neck. The image highlights the textured scales, a large circular subtympanic shield below the ear area, a prominent eye with a round pupil, and the beginning of a dorsal crest along the nape. The background is dark and out of focus.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: High-resolution detail shows distinct granular texture on the neck and larger, smoother plate-like scales on the snout and cheek.
